prompt: Which country was the first outside of Africa to detect a case of mpox in the most recent outbreak? Note that the first human cases were diagnosed in 1970.
answer: The **United Kingdom** was the first country outside Africa to detect a case in the **2022 global mpox outbreak**. The case was reported on **6 May 2022** in a person who had recently traveled from Nigeria.
